title: No cinema com Nico
grammar: Was/were em perguntas e respostas curtas
goal: Comece a pergunta com Was ou Were e responda com Yes, it was ou No, they were not.
reading: Nico and Peg were at the movie.
Nico e Peg estavam no filme.
Their seats were in the front row.
Os assentos deles eram na primeira fileira.
The movie was short and the end was funny.
O filme foi curto e o final foi engraçado.
Peg was happy after the movie.
Peg estava feliz depois do filme.
dialogue: Yes, it was. It was funny.
Você estava em casa antes das dez?
Yes, I was. Nico was home too.
Sim. O Nico também estava em casa.
pron: Em perguntas sim/não a voz sobe no final: Was it good? ↗
gram: Os assentos eram perto da porta?
Seats é plural, então usamos Were.
